lokele: Paulo la Silwano la Timoteo, iso tosotoma lokasa-lo ende eb’Etanda ya Tesalonika eyomani la Mungu Sango wasu la Ngɛnɛ ako Yesu Masiya.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

lokele: Booto la lilatemi elia Mungu Sango la Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya biyaleke lanu!
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Lole loasu ndofaekefa Mungu kelekele eoka yanu mbile bitotina, Bitungani, kwa aondu nde eoka ya lilendelu lianu lisokonda finɛ la lisamani lianu yaatotina, boto la boto, lisoulwaka finɛ.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, 1:3 even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

lokele: Ongoma tosoomala loasɔ loanu nda bitanda ya Mungu eoka ya likɔkɔmɛlɛ lianu la lilendelu lianu nda bakongolomu la bifembi ebisokak’ino. Loasɔ loa likongolomu lia eb’Etanda
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

lokele: Ongoma, njasɔ-bi bile ndembe yɔɛnɛs’iso likomyi lia liengani lia Mungu mbo ino botangomoko ebengani ba Bɔkɔta wa Mungu, ani ino imɔ osoka biale eoka ya wao.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

lokele: Ambo Mungu nd’asosakanesel’iyo bifembi ebasokes’ino ko bifembi,
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

lokele: la atofaef’ino ebasoka bifembi ko lɔɛumɔ amamwito lasu imɔ, ani akaɛnɛlɛkɛ Ngɛnɛ Yesu ndosokwa nda Use amamwito la bakitomo bande ba bofoka,
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

lokele: ko la bosä wa loiloi, la atotena likuchi lia ebatiluwe Mungu l’ebatilitese Mboli Ilau ya Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

lokele: Iyo ana belakuchomoko la lisɛɛsɛli lia lokato, belasɛnyaka shɛi la bɔmbɔ wa Ngɛnɛ nda tala ya bofoka wande,
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

lokele: ani akayek’Inde nda lise lina ndotaliomo tala ko la ebasüchomo lande la ndomwaalomo ende batotina ebimelaka, eoka inango shasu shonangoel’ino sisoimelomo wewe.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

lokele: Ko l’eoka-ye totosombokoel’ino mbile la mbile, mbo Mungu wasu atangeke ino mbo wengani nde wotomo lande lioi la mbo aɔlɔlɛkɛ basangi batotina banu balau la bekeeli ya lilendelu ebisokelak’ino ko la bofoka wande,
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

lokele: mbo lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu litaliomoko tala ko lanu, la ino imɔ ko lande, eoka ya booto wa Mungu wasu la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus 1:12 may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Bitungani, nda loasɔ loa bayelo ba Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya la lɔsɔngɔmɔ loasu lotowana lande, tosoomb’ino
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

lokele: mbo botaeyaeya futuku nda baenyeli banu, la mbo otasisimwa ango loasɔ loa bolimo, ango ko lioi ango ko lokasa eloongomu mbo losekwi nde ende’mi mbo Lise lia Ngɛnɛ lisoya kwani.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

lokele: Boto angɔmɔi atalimbëk’ino la mboka ango ɛmɔi, eoka lise lina angotaya kɔni, sakolo ngo ko inanesa sifi siya oso la Ewa litefoli koyaɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ oso, ako wana wa lɔsɛɛsɛlɔ,
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion 2:3 falling away defection comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

lokele: oyatotefwesa la oyatoomala l’ifala mbo asolonga oyasotangomo Mungu la bitotina ebisosemolomo la bato, kwa mbo ayali nde nda këka ya eyaelo ya Mungu angɛnɛ l’ani atotaka boeki mbo ale ko Mungu.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

lokele: ¿Otienyel’imɔ mbo yakambesak’ino njasɔ-bi ani ayalaka’mi oko lanu?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

lokele: La kwani oluwi nde bofoka ebokokufesel’inde mbo aiselomoko nda lisho elitinyomu inde.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

lokele: Nde litefoli elisoisama likokelaka likuwa liande kwani, ko ɔmɔi nd’atokufekesa liao kond’atosekwa liao sisi yasu.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

lokele: Lamao to Ewa litefoli atoisolomo fololo la Ngɛnɛ Yesu eolak’inde ko la luli lia bɔnɔkɔ wande la esɛɛsɛlɛk’inde ko la liameli lia bayelo bande.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

lokele: Bayelo bande bale ko l’eoka ya bekeeli ya Satana ko la bofoka la ndembe ya bisisho ya bolimbakeli,
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

lokele: la bɔlɔwanɛ bototina bobe wolimbaka ebatosɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔ, eoka batiakuliaka losamɔ loa njasɔ ya wewe nda betema mbo buwesomoko.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

lokele: Eokao to, Mungu asotomel’iyo botwanelesi wa bofoka oyatolimbak’iyo mbo bimeleke ko lolanga lona,
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

lokele: mbo batotina ebatiaimelaka njasɔ ya wewe l’ebasoomala la linɛngina lia njasɔ ebitiengane, iyo ana bafomoko se. Baolo ba kelekele la bakakanelo ende eb’Etanda
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

lokele: Nde lole loasu ndofaekefa Mungu kelekele eoka yanu mbile bitoti, ino Bitungani ebasamomu la Ngɛnɛ wasu, eoka mbo Mungu nd’aak’ino nda liako mbo uwesomoko ko la loukameso loa Bolimo la lilendelu lia njasɔ ya wewe.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

lokele: La Mungu asot’ino lioi ko la Mboli Ilau ebisonangoel’iso end’ino, mbo ino ɔɔlɛkɛ tala ebiomani la Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Eokao, Bitungani, kɔkɔmɛlɛkɛ la undaka ko ngwi liekesi eliaɔlɔk’ino end’iso ango ko la lioi lia bɔnɔkɔ, ango ko la lokasa loasu.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

lokele: Nde Ngɛnɛ wasu angɛnɛ ako Yesu Masiya, la Mungu Sango wasu, oyasamak’iso la oyafak’iso liɔnjɔnji elitilasilek’imɔ la iɛli silau ko la booto wande,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

lokele: afumbeseke betema yanu ndokɔkɔmɛsɛ yao nda bekeeli bitotina bilau la nda baoi batotina balau.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

lokele: Tuu ya loasɔ, Bitungani, sombokoelak’iso mbo wɛndi wa Ngɛnɛ wendeseke la botaliomoko tala, kwa asokelaka wao sisi yanu,
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

lokele: la mbo tɔɔnɔkɔlɔmɔkɔ nda besamba ya bato babe ebatiengane, eoka bati to batotina nd’ayali la lilendelu.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

lokele: Kongo ko Ngɛnɛ wasu nd’ayali wolendelomo la Inde atokɔkɔmɛs’ino kɔkɛ la atotingana lanu mbo Ewa obe atakwes’ino.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

lokele: Tosolendelo imɔ Ngɛnɛ loasɔ loanu mbo bokokela la bokelak’imo ko njasɔ bina ebisot’iso otel’ino ekela.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu alongameseke to betema yanu fii nda mboka ya losamɔ loa Mungu la nda likɔkɔmɛlɛ lia Masiya. Ndola la beimo ya Paulo ende Etanda
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

lokele: Tosotel’ino ndola, Bitungani, ko la lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, mbo ɔsɛnyanɛkɛ l’ebaitokɛsɛnɛ l’ebamɔi nda likuwa la ebaitolitesa liekesi elisɔɔl’ino end’iso.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

lokele: Eoka ino angɛnɛ nd’aluwi mbo lole loanu ndotutel’iso; mbo ayalak’iso omolo eyanu, totiakɛndɛkɛndɛkɛ wawa,
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

lokele: la totialaka bieka ya boto sakolo ko ndokamb’inde, kongo ko twakelaka likuwa lia bonui la likati, la ocho la löwa, litina mbo totayala la bolito end’ino ango ɔmɔi.
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

lokele: Eti to mbo toti l’isosha ongoma, kangä to mbo boyaeli wasu angɛnɛ bofek’ino etichelo mbo otutelek’iso.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

lokele: Eoka eyayalak’iso lanu, twatelak’ino ekela mbo— Boto atikulye ndokela likuwa, alëke bieka!
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

lokele: Tosokaka to mbo bamɔi banu baitokɛsɛnɛ l’ebamɔi nda likuwa, baitokelaka likuwa, batoetaeta okela ko likeëlä.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

lokele: Tosota to bɔfɔnɔ-bo wa bato ndola la tosolɔmbɔkɔl’iyo la lina lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya mbo bakeleke likuwa liau ko la hai la wɛlï, mbo baleke eyau angɛnɛ bieka.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

lokele: Kongo ko, Bitungani, otɛkwɛ̈kɛ ndokelaka bolau.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

lokele: Nde, boto atilitese lioi elisɔni nd’iso nda lokasa-lo, luwaka boto ona ko la ndembe, angoyalana lande imɔ lisaɔ mbo boto ona okeke sɔni
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

lokele: nde otangëk’inde mbo wiyani, kangä koimak’inde kwa etungani yanu. Lisomboli lia losilo loa lokasa
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

lokele: Inde angɛnɛ ako Ngɛnɛ wa lilatemi afaefek’ino lilatemi mbile bitoti la nda beyaeli bitotina; Ngɛnɛ wasu ayaleke lanu yaatotina!
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

lokele: Liseeli-li ko l’ewami bosamba ako Paulo; lile to ndembe yolembeela kasa bitotina yami, itosonoko ngo ko anyo.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

lokele: Booto wa Ngɛnɛ wasu Yesu Masiya boyalakeke lanu yaatotina!
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
